_comment: Timely filing limits from public sources. 'verified' means the limit was confirmed against the cited public source; unverified entries are shown to reviewers as such. The federal floor (42 CFR 447.45(d)(1)) requires states to accept claims submitted within 12 months of the date of service.

UT.name: Utah Medicaid (fee-for-service)
citations: Utah Medicaid Provider Agreement: amended claims accepted up to 365 days after date of service, https://medicaid.utah.gov/Documents/pdfs/agreement2011.pdf

AZ.name: AHCCCS (fee-for-service)
citations: A.R.S. 36-2904(G); AHCCCS FFS Provider Billing Manual, Chapter 4 General Billing Rules, https://azahcccs.gov/PlansProviders/Downloads/FFSProviderManual/FFS_Chap04GeneralBillingRules.pdf

NV.name: Nevada Medicaid (fee-for-service)
citations: Nevada Medicaid and Nevada Check Up Billing Manual, timely filing (180 days from DOS in-state; 365 out-of-state/TPL), https://www.medicaid.nv.gov/Downloads/provider/NV_Billing_General_20190318.pdf
Correction window not separately confirmed; using the initial limit.

ID.name: Idaho Medicaid (fee-for-service)
citations: Idaho manual section for the 12-month limit not yet confirmed.
